newsitem.title: CANADA: Grad & Walker in C$46.6 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Grad & Walker in C$46.6 mln share issue.

text.p: Grad & Walker Energy Corp said on Monday it entered into a bought-deal financing agreement for Grad & Walker Energy to issue from treasury 3.0 million common shares and a secondary issue of 1.2 million common shares from Grad & Walker Resources Ltd at C$11.10 per common share for an aggregate issue of C$46.62 million.

Grad & Walker said proceeds from the treasury portion of the issue would be used to fund Grad & Walker Energy's ongoing oil and natural gas acquisition, exploration and development activities. Activities include programs at Marengo/Mantario, Pinkham/East Mantario in western Saskatchewan and Three Hills Creek in east central Alberta.
